mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing tramadol plasma concentrations and active metabolite (M1) levels, raising risk of seizures, serotonin syndrome, and respiratory depression.
action: Consider alternative antibiotic; if co-administration necessary, reduce tramadol dose and monitor closely for adverse effects including seizures, serotonin toxicity, and CNS/respiratory depression.
